# UX Checklist: macOS Virtual Audio Driver MVP

**Purpose**: Requirement-quality gate for onboarding, tray/widget, Audio Health, accessibility, recovery copy, and brand distance.
**Created**: 2026-05-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are onboarding requirements complete for install state, permission state, virtual device visibility, physical device selection, and route verification? [Completeness, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK002 Are visible capture indicator requirements complete for ready, active, paused, degraded, error, and stopped states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015..FR-017, Data Model §CaptureSession]
- [x] CHK003 Are Audio Health requirements complete for physical mic, physical output, virtual mic, virtual speaker, route graph, meters, verification, driver status, permissions, test recording, and playback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK004 Are uninstall and manual-remediation UX requirements complete for partial cleanup and OS-managed artifacts? [Completeness, Spec §US4, §FR-025..FR-026]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "one-action stop" defined clearly enough for tray/widget and any other visible local surface? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK006 Are user-visible failure states named and distinguished enough to avoid mixing driver, route, permission, physical device, server, and network failures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 Is best-effort labeling for unsupported meeting targets and devices specified in user-facing language requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]

## Accessibility And Localization

- [x] CHK008 Are accessibility requirements specified for non-color cues, keyboard-reachable stop, state labels, and screen-reader-safe capture state? [Coverage, Spec §UX/Brand/Accessibility Impact]
- [x] CHK009 Are localization-safe label requirements specified for device names, status labels, recovery actions, and diagnostic/deletion copy? [Coverage, Spec §UX/Brand/Accessibility Impact]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for long device names and browser/app names without truncating critical state meaning? [Coverage, Spec §FR-038]

## Brand Distance

- [x] CHK011 Are clean-room UI requirements specific enough to prevent copying Krisp layout, copy, icons, or brand language while preserving the product category expectations? [Clarity, Spec §UX/Brand/Accessibility Impact]
- [x] CHK012 Is brand-distance review represented as a release gate for onboarding, tray/widget, Audio Health, installer, and uninstall flows? [Completeness, Constitution §Product And Platform Constraints]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK013 Are requirements defined for the user being in a live meeting while the app needs repair, update, route recovery, or disk/buffer remediation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for browser/device changes mid-session so the UI does not show stale readiness? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for truthful copy when capture is degraded or a required track is missing? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028]
